datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC classifications were collected for multiple scenarios and time periods (February, June, October 2017) and compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) with classification scales and period metadata.
